verdict.rationale: Skyvern serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document at api.skyvern.com/openapi.json, and its per-endpoint API reference and in-browser playground are generated from that spec. The spec also marks deprecated endpoints. The probe's 404s were on skyvern.com paths, not the api.skyvern.com host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec download (the probe did not check api.skyvern.com), and a documented discoverable download link or path on the main domain.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
